title: JA Restaurant EmDash 1.0.4 and JA Diner EmDash 0.1.4 have template-profiles rows of their own, so the Customize readiness rules no longer fall back to 1.0.3 / 0.1.3
steps: S1: In the checkout after pnpm install, run run.cmd (no database, no network).
S2: Confirm every test in the file reports ok.
expect: templateProfileOf('tracy-restaurant/emdash-0.x', '1.0.4') and templateProfileOf('tracy-diner/emdash-0.x', '0.1.4') answer their own version, not a fallback.
Their logos, brandReady and faviconReady equal those of 1.0.3 and 0.1.3.
fence: every EmDash version a restaurant/diner tag publishes has its own template-profiles row
